title: Add inventory CSV export
prompt: Add export_csv(store, path) to inventory/storage.py. Write the header sku,name,category,unit_price,quantity, then one row per item sorted by SKU. Use category values and format prices with exactly two decimal places. Write UTF-8 CSV with LF line endings. Add a csv subcommand to the CLI that takes an output path, as in python -m inventory.cli --input stock.json csv stock.csv. Add tests for the export and CLI. All tests must pass with python -m pytest -q.
